market_read: Week 3 snapshot: 18 verified rows, 0 indicative. All 17 prior-week rows held asking prices unchanged for a second consecutive week and no listings went to 404, confirming a fully static seller market with no visible negotiation pressure. Verified range holds at PHP 269–3,000/sqm; overall median unchanged at PHP 1,200/sqm. New this week: Lumban Primera Parang, 4.1 ha bare land at PHP 1,127/sqm — the first Lumban parcel to pass all filters, landing near the dataset median. The Pagsanjan-core median (8 rows, PHP 975/sqm) versus ring median (10 rows, PHP 1,600/sqm) continues to reflect a parcel-size artefact rather than a location discount, as the core hosts most of the large 5+ ha lots. For a raw 0.5–1 ha Pagsanjan parcel the tightest comparables remain Maulawin (4,767 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm) and Bulilan Norte/Pila (6,447 sqm, PHP 2,000/sqm), supporting an asking range of PHP 1,600–2,000/sqm; PHP 1,400/sqm remains the fastest-sale suggestion, unchanged from baseline.
